sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Treasure Hunter:
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by L.
Recovers 5 Cost.
Performs a critical hit.
Ability Power scales with the number of Dark elemental Lance/Bow/Staff type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 4XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 6).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Treasure Hunter.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Dark elemental Lance/Bow/Staff type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
